researchQuestion: Can strictly point-in-time SEC filing data identify an operational growth-emergence signal before GQS-00 confirmation, and does that signal add out-of-sample information beyond unchanged GQS-00?

directedHypotheses.claim: Higher fundamental GES ranks predict higher subsequent revenue and gross-profit growth.
GES retains positive incremental rank information after controlling for contemporaneous GQS-00, sector, size and market regime.
The GES top decile has higher subsequent sector-and-size-matched total return than the investable universe after the fixed transaction-cost assumption.
Adding the secondary market-recognition factor improves or preserves validation-window rank IC without increasing test-window maximum drawdown by more than 20 percent relative.

exclusionsPrimary: ETF, fund, preferred, warrant, unit or debt security
foreign private issuer or ADR in the primary analysis
bank, insurer, REIT or pre-revenue biotechnology company
universe.excludedGroupHandling: Banks, insurers, REITs and pre-revenue biotechnology are retained only as separately reported secondary strata and never pooled into the primary cohort.

marketCapUsd.timestamp: last fully known close before signal availability

liquidity.measure: median daily dollar volume over the 60 completed trading sessions before availability

universe.deduplication: One historical entity_id per economic entity. At each signal date select the eligible US primary listing with the highest prior-60-session median dollar volume; ties use listing_id ascending. No current ticker mapping may be projected backward.
universe.sectorHandling: Primary percentiles are computed within historical GICS-like sector and size bucket. If fewer than 30 eligible entities are present, fall back to sector, then the full eligible universe; the fallback level is recorded.

informationTiming.factAvailability: known_at = max(observed_at, source_published_at, filed_at/SEC acceptance timestamp); known_at must be <= evaluation timestamp
informationTiming.secCutoff: Use the SEC acceptance timestamp. If an issuer release with an independently captured publication timestamp is used, availability is the later timestamp.
informationTiming.restatements: Use the original as-filed revision known at the timestamp. Later amendments and restatements are separate source_revision rows and cannot overwrite the original.
informationTiming.signalEvents: 10-Q and 10-K filing events; amended filings create a new event only when they change at least one eligible input fact.
informationTiming.execution: First regular-session open strictly after availability. If availability precedes that day's open, that open is eligible; otherwise use the next trading-session open.
informationTiming.portfolioSnapshots: At each calendar month-end use the most recent eligible filing signal known before the next execution open; signals older than 180 calendar days are stale and excluded.
prohibitedLookahead: facts filed or released after the evaluation timestamp
current ticker/entity maps without effective dates
later-restated values substituted for original filings
final delisting status as a feature
consensus or estimate histories not captured point in time

factorPreprocessing.quarterConstruction: Derive stand-alone quarters from as-filed quarterly values; for cumulative YTD cash-flow facts subtract the immediately prior cumulative fact from the same accession/fiscal year. Ambiguous duration/context rows are quarantined.
factorPreprocessing.scaling: Per factor and event date, winsorize finite raw values at the training-window p1/p99 learned without validation/test rows, then convert to cohort midrank percentiles on [0,100].
factorPreprocessing.missingness: No imputation. A composite requires at least 4 of 5 primary factors. Present weights are renormalized; coverage count and weight are reported and used as a control variable.
factorPreprocessing.minimumHistory: Eight stand-alone fiscal quarters for acceleration factors; otherwise the affected factor is missing. No annual fallback is introduced into GES v1.0.0.

inputs: SEC as-filed quarterly cost of revenue q0..q7

primary.formula: mean(gp_q0/rev_q0, gp_q1/rev_q1) - mean(gp_q2/rev_q2, gp_q3/rev_q3, gp_q4/rev_q4, gp_q5/rev_q5)
inputs: SEC as-filed quarterly gross profit q0..q5

primary.formula: mean(opinc_q0/rev_q0, opinc_q1/rev_q1) - mean(opinc_q2/rev_q2, opinc_q3/rev_q3, opinc_q4/rev_q4, opinc_q5/rev_q5)
inputs: SEC as-filed quarterly operating income q0..q5
SEC as-filed entity common shares outstanding at q0 and q4 period ends

factors.primaryComposite: GES_F = weighted mean of available primary factor percentiles; require >=4 factors; renormalize the fixed equal weights over present factors.

inputs: point-in-time adjusted closes through the last completed session before availability
secondary.note: The 6-to-1-month term measures established recognition; the 1-month term measures recent confirmation. Both stop before the filing becomes available.

secondary.reason: No licensed point-in-time consensus snapshot store exists. It is excluded from v1.0.0 and may only enter a new preregistered protocol version.

factors.secondaryComposite: GES_FM = 0.8 * GES_F + 0.2 * market_recognition_percentile. Missing market recognition makes GES_FM missing; it never changes GES_F.
factors.baseline: GQS-00@1.0.0 is executed unchanged on the same as-of event snapshots. No GQS weight, axis, track, filter, factor or ranking rule may be retuned.

targets.maturityRule: A row/horizon is not evaluated until the complete horizon and any delisting outcome are observable. Immature rows are reported only as counts, never as successes or failures.

validation.scheme: nested expanding walk-forward; never random shuffle
validation.selectionRule: Only factor availability mappings, concept aliases and data-quality rules may be selected in train/validation. The formulas and weights in this protocol are fixed. Test windows are opened once per protocol version after all readiness gates pass.
validation.embargo: A filing event for an entity cannot occur in both sides of a split boundary; assign by availability date. Overlapping forward outcomes use entity-clustered, calendar-block inference.
ablations: GQS-00 alone versus GQS-00 plus GES_F
stressPeriods: 2008-style stress unavailable before 2010 and therefore not claimed

incremental: partial rank IC controlling for GQS-00, sector, size and regime
nested-model likelihood or out-of-sample loss improvement where applicable
metrics.inference: Entity-clustered calendar-block bootstrap with 10,000 resamples; report point estimate, 95% interval and effective sample size.

costsAndOutcomes.prices: Only subsequent split/dividend-adjusted prices may define outcomes; no outcome price enters a feature.
costsAndOutcomes.delisting: Use the documented cash/stock consideration when available. Otherwise a terminal disappearance after verified delisting is -100%; unresolved series endings are quarantined and reported, not silently dropped.
costsAndOutcomes.corporateActions: Map outcomes through effective-dated listing/entity events; mergers roll into documented consideration, never today's surviving ticker by assumption.

multipleTesting.family: All stated horizons, composites, liquidity variants, subgroup strata and ablations within this protocol version
multipleTesting.reporting: All registered tests are reported, including null and adverse results.

success: H1: GES_F has positive primary fundamental rank IC in at least two of three test windows and the pooled block-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero after FDR control.
H2: incremental partial rank IC over GQS-00 is positive in at least two test windows and pooled adjusted q <= 0.05.
H3: the GES_F top decile has positive after-cost matched excess return in at least two mature test windows and no test window has a statistically significant negative spread after FDR control.
falsification: Incremental rank IC over GQS-00 <= 0 or reverses sign in two test windows.
Top-decile after-cost matched excess return <= 0 in two mature test windows.
Results disappear when entities below USD 2bn or COVID/AI-boom periods are excluded.
abort: Any point-in-time leakage or inability to reconstruct original as-filed revisions.
Historical entity/listing linkage precision below 99.5% on the adjudicated audit sample.
More than 5% unresolved delisting outcomes in an evaluated test window.
Primary factor coverage below 60% of otherwise eligible entity-events in two consecutive calendar years.
Any modification to formulas, weights or success rules after test outcomes are viewed; such a change requires a new protocol version and a fresh unopened test window.

requiredBeforeRun: append-only original-as-filed SEC fact store with acceptance timestamps
frozen concept map and coverage report
independent audit sample passing all exit criteria
readinessGate.prohibitedNow: Do not compute pilot outcomes, inspect test-window performance, choose weights from results, or publish a winner.

changeLog.change: Initial preregistration. Narrows the source protocol to domestic SEC filers, fixes five equal-weight fundamental factors, excludes unavailable consensus history, and freezes exact execution and decision rules before outcome access.

integrity.canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys; preserve array order; JSON.stringify without whitespace; UTF-8.
integrity.hashScope: This JSON after replacing integrity.canonicalSha256 with null.
